from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/workspace/assets/sprites/platformer_coins.jpg').convert('RGB')
w, h = img.size
# Let's examine several candidate gem sprites more closely
# Check row 2 (index 2), cols that have interesting colors
# Actually let me just print all pixels for sprites (3,1) red, (10,1) gold

for (sx, sy) in [(3,1), (16,1), (18,2), (19,2), (20,2), (21,2)]:

                line += '.'

                line += '#'
        print(f'  y={y%70}: {line}')
